title: What's New in Shopify Connector: Troubleshoot Synchronization (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Sync in foreground and logging mode setup
Customer synchronization issues and error handling
Inventory level synchronization and location configuration
Inspecting received information and creating sales documents
Archiving documents and unlinking processed orders
Handling refunds and creating credit memos
Investigating failed shipments and document updates

features.name: Sync in foreground mode
features.description: Allows synchronization to run in the foreground instead of through job queue, providing clear error messages and better visibility during troubleshooting.

features.name: Logging mode configuration
features.description: Three logging options available: Error only, All, and Disabled. Error only saves disk space when connector is running smoothly; All mode logs all entries for troubleshooting.
caveats: Error only mode saves disk space but misses detailed logging

features.name: Customer validation and skip notification
features.description: Connector runs checks on customers and notifies users with friendly error messages when records are skipped due to validation issues like missing email addresses.
caveats: Email address is required for customer export to Shopify

features.name: Log entry details for synchronization
features.description: Connector logs each operation with detailed transaction entries showing attempts to find or create records, including successful and failed entries with response details.
caveats: Log entries show all operations even if some fail

features.name: Inventory tracking on products
features.description: Inventory tracking must be activated on products for stock level synchronization with Shopify.

features.name: Location filter and stock calculation options
features.description: Location filters must be configured with one of three stock calculation options: projected available balance at date, and free inventory not reserved. Customizations may use different methods.
caveats: Customized stock calculations may require partner assistance

features.name: Shopify inventory fact box
features.description: Product page displays a fact box showing inventory levels by location, last update time, and a comparison of Business Central stock with Shopify stock.

features.name: Location export toggles for products
features.description: Toggles to activate location export when exporting products. When activated, automatically lists all configured locations as sources for inventory in Shopify.
caveats: Must be activated before exporting products to Shopify

features.name: Create item action for unknown products
features.description: New action allows manual creation of Business Central items from unmapped Shopify products using the create item button in the products list.
caveats: Automatic creation may fail due to template issues or number series constraints

features.name: Has error and error message columns
features.description: Product list now shows has error toggle and error message columns to display validation errors directly in the products list.

features.name: Compare at price display
features.description: Product variants display a compare at price field showing the full price before discount, in addition to the discounted price.

features.name: Archived order detection
features.description: Archived orders in Shopify are not imported to Business Central automatically. Users must unarchive orders in Shopify admin to enable import.
caveats: Archived orders are filtered out by default

features.name: Shopify orders to import table
features.description: Separate table showing all Shopify orders available for import, allowing users to selectively import specific orders instead of bulk import.
caveats: Archived orders in Shopify will not be imported

features.name: Import selected order action
features.description: Action allowing users to select specific orders from the Shopify orders to import table and import only those orders.

features.name: Has error field for imported orders
features.description: A field in the Shopify orders to import table that indicates if an order has errors during import, with details available in the record details section.

features.name: Inspect received information from Shopify orders
features.description: Ability to view detailed information received from Shopify for orders, including header information and line details, to understand which data was received and identify missing information.

features.name: Shopify order fact box on sales documents
features.description: A fact box that displays key numbers from both the Shopify order and the created sales document, helping users verify if tax calculation and other configurations are correct.
caveats: Works with both sales orders and sales invoices

features.name: Shopify related fields in archived sales documents
features.description: Fields visible in archived sales documents that store Shopify references: Shopify order ID in header and Shopify order line ID in lines, useful for exploring shipping scenarios.
caveats: Only visible when document is archived

features.name: Unlink processor documents
features.description: Button to unlink a processed Shopify order that has been deleted or needs re-import, marking it as not linked so a new sales document can be created after synchronization.
caveats: Only applies to deleted documents that remain marked as processed

features.name: Sync order from Shopify function
features.description: Function to import updates from Shopify for a specific order, allowing users to pull the latest information about quantity, shipping charges or other changes without reimporting the entire order.

features.name: Create credit memo for refunds
features.description: New feature to create a credit memo from a refunded order in Shopify, intended for consultants configuring the connector and testing scenarios where refund accounts may not be properly configured.
caveats: Requires proper refund account configuration in Shopify shop
Mainly for consultant use during configuration

features.name: Fulfillment information in Shopify orders
features.description: Displays fulfillment and fulfillment order details for Shopify orders, showing what is pending or marked as closed, to help identify synchronization conflicts.
caveats: Requires manual checking of Shopify admin when conflicts occur

features.name: Sync orders from Shopify action on fulfillment
features.description: Action to sync order data from Shopify to see if fulfillment information has changed, helping identify if an order was fulfilled in Shopify after being posted as shipped in Business Central.

features.name: Shopify fulfillment ID field on sales shipment
features.description: Field on posted sales shipment documents that shows the Shopify fulfillment ID, which becomes minus one if synchronization fails, indicating a problem that needs resolution.
caveats: Shows minus one on failed synchronization
Can be manually edited to retry synchronization

features.name: Shopify activities line showing KPIs
features.description: A view showing key performance indicators for Shopify synchronization including missing mappings, pending orders, failed shipments, job queue failures, and conflicting updates that need attention.
caveats: Requires manual review and resolution of identified issues
